welcome:
Welcome to MAAS (Metal as a Service) CLI!
Manage your physical servers like virtual machines.
Type 'help' to see available commands.

login.description: Log in to a MAAS server

handler.output: Successfully logged in to MAAS at {{maasUrl}}

logout.description: Log out from the MAAS server

else.output: You are not currently logged in
Please log in first using 'login' command

deploy.description: Deploy an operating system to a machine

else.output: Please log in first using 'login' command

release.description: Release a deployed or allocated machine

then.name: systemId
then.message: Enter machine system ID to release:

then.name: confirm
then.message: Release machine {{systemId}}? This will erase the disk.

then.output: Machine {{systemId}} has been released and is ready for reuse
